answer.rationale: Roll out the validated shorter, simpler self-serve onboarding flow to improve time-to-value and durable early activation for SMB accounts without competing on unsustainable price. Do not match the deeper discount: exp_73 showed strong initial acquisition and qualified-revenue lift but a 12% 30-day retention decline and failure to survive the first renewal cycle. Onboarding will not fully offset price-driven churn, but it is the strongest available sustainable SMB-oriented lever.
